item.title: Weighted Diversified Sampling for Efficient \n Data-Driven Single-Cell Gene-Gene Interaction Discovery
item.author: wu0001810@umn.edu (Yifan Wu)
item.description:
• Venue: NeurIPS AIDrugX Workshop; NeurIPS FM4Science Workshop
  • Preprint: arXiv
  • Citation: “Yifan Wu, Yuntao Yang, Zirui Liu, Zhao Li, Khushbu Pahwa, Rongbin Li, Wenjin Zheng, Xia Hu, Zhaozhuo Xu. "Weighted Diversified Sampling for Efficient Data-Driven Single-Cell Gene-Gene Interaction Discovery." ICLR, 2025. (Under review)”

Gene-gene interactions play a crucial role in the manifestation of complex human diseases. Uncovering significant gene-gene interactions is a challenging task. Here, we present an innovative approach utilizing data-driven computational tools, leveraging an advanced Transformer model, to unearth noteworthy gene-gene interactions.
